name: ak:review-pr
overview: Review a GitHub pull request thoroughly — analyze diff for correctness, security, breaking changes, code quality, and AI-slop patterns. Supports --fix to auto-remediate findings, --reply to post the review back to GitHub via the gh CLI as a formal review, and --merge to merge a ready PR and watch post-merge CI to green.
whenToUse: Invoke to review a GitHub PR by number/URL, optionally fix findings, optionally post the review back to GitHub, optionally merge when ready and watch CI.
